items.title: 2026: The Year Agentic AI Becomes the Attack-Surface Poster Child

items.title: Microsoft to disable NTLM by default in future Windows releases
items.description: Microsoft announced that it will disable the 30-year-old NTLM authentication protocol by default in upcoming Windows releases due to security vulnerabilities that expose organizations to cyberattacks. [...]

items.title: Trump Administration Rescinds Biden-Era Software Guidance
